newsitem.title: CHINA: China paper hits misleading company reports.
newsitem.headline: China paper hits misleading company reports.

text.p: Some of China's listed companies are using misleading advertisements and newspaper reports to lure investors and boost their share prices, an official newspaper said on Thursday.
It said that investors were being snared in traps set for them during the public offering period and after listing.
"Looking at various reports on listed firms in recent years, we are deeply puzzled and worried about the motives," the Financial News said in a commentary.
These companies were benefiting from favourable investment analyses that were touting the stock.
"The reports make no mention of real value (of their shares) and become 'traps' to lure investors and create a market."
It did not name any of the companies involved.
The China Securities Regulatory Commission, the country's top securities watchdog, tightened its grip on media coverage of stocks in July. It banned false reporting on stocks.
